title: できれば静かに見ててほしい

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It's always so relaxing to come here and watch the stars alone…)

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Is this that hidden spot that went viral?! There's so many people. The power of the internet is scary.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, babe, this is soooo romantic! C'mon, tell me how my eyes sparkle like the stars! Pleeeease?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd's commotion completely ruins Admire Vega's night.
